info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Knowledge Asset Update API
info.description: The Knowledge Asset Update API allows for the modification of existing knowledge assets within the banking domain. This endpoint facilitates the update of specific attributes of knowledge assets, enabling organizations to ensure that their information remains current and relevant. Typical consumers include financial institutions and developers looking to enhance knowledge sharing and resource management. By using this endpoint, clients can effectively maintain the accuracy of their knowledge resources, support regulatory compliance, and foster collaboration across their teams.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific knowledge exchange resource identified by its unique ID (RES-100045). You can modify various attributes of the resource to keep the information up-to-date.

requestBody.description: Update the specified knowledge asset in the knowledge exchange system by providing the necessary data in the request body.
